title: nnInteractive Agent: General-Purpose AI Agents as 3D Image Annotators
abstract: arXiv:2610.31080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Interactive 3D segmentation models such as nnInteractive turn a few spatial prompts (points, scribbles, boxes) into accurate volumetric masks, but a human still does the annotation work: finding each structure, placing prompts, checking the result and correcting it. General-purpose AI agents can now interpret images, call tools and write code. We show that such agents can take over this work without additional training: the user makes a request in plain language, and the agent works out what has to be segmented, locates the targets, prompts nnInteractive, inspects the 3D result, corrects it and responds to feedback. Asked for 'the muscles used for chewing', an agent identifies and segments the masseters and pterygoids; asked to count liver lesions, it writes its own code to find candidates and splits a merged lesion on request. Our open-source nninteractive-agent provides nnInteractive as tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), toge

translated_title: nnInteractive智能体：作为3D图像标注器的通用人工智能体
translated_abstract: 诸如nnInteractive之类的交互式3D分割模型可以将少量空间提示（点、涂鸦、框）转换为精确的体积掩膜，但标注工作仍需人工完成：寻找每个结构、放置提示、检查结果并进行修正。通用人工智能体如今已能够解读图像、调用工具并编写代码。我们证明这类智能体无需额外训练即可接管这项工作：用户用自然语言提出请求，智能体便会确定需要分割的内容、定位目标、为nnInteractive提供提示、检查3D结果、进行修正并响应反馈。当被要求找出“用于咀嚼的肌肉”时，智能体能够识别并分割咬肌和翼状肌；当被要求计算肝脏病变数量时，它会自行编写代码查找候选区域，并可根据要求拆分粘连在一起的病变。我们的开源nninteractive-agent通过模型上下文协议将nnInteractive作为工具提供，……
tldr: 该论文提出开源的nninteractive-agent系统，让通用AI智能体无需额外训练即可根据自然语言指令自动完成3D图像标注的全流程工作（定位目标、提示分割、检查与修正结果），通过将nnInteractive封装为MCP工具实现了交互式分割的全自动化。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces an open-source general-purpose AI agent that, without additional training, fully automates 3D image annotation—locating targets, prompting segmentation, and inspecting and correcting results—by exposing nnInteractive as MCP tools driven by plain-language user requests.
